note: Silhouette scores compare visible boundaries only, not internal geometry, wood, lighting or unseen surfaces. Original controls overall proportions; the accepted side guide directs the head/button join.

internal_features.finial: The shallow button, direct head contact and full-depth mitre slit remain exact from checkpoint 022.
internal_features.collars: The accepted collar rims, heights and middle-lip overhang remain exact from checkpoint 022.
internal_features.lower_body: Only mid-stem radii 34-36 are narrowed. Every height, the lower-stem controls at the root, socket, flare, groove and foot are retained. Actual contour rays separate the stem boundary from the rear base; the unsupported subpixel shoulder adjustment is omitted. Level views check that the earlier lower-stem bulge has not been reintroduced.
internal_features.limits: The accepted side guide is art direction, not a recovered source camera. Boxwood pigment, surface relief and reflections are an unfinished reconstruction. Single-view evidence cannot determine hidden geometry uniquely. The retained pigment and lights have not been refitted to this geometry; neutral comparison is required.
